images.title: What a paid tier can add
images.alt: Four kinds of paid newsletter content: depth, specifics, access to Q&A or community, and the archive of older issues.
images.caption: The paid tier should add something a reader can describe, while the free tier stays good.

images.title: Percentage cut vs flat monthly fee
images.alt: Comparison of newsletter platforms that take a percentage of paid subscriptions with those that charge a flat monthly fee.
images.caption: A percentage is cheaper when you're small; a flat fee usually wins once paid revenue grows.
images.note: Payment processor fees apply on top either way
